milestones.title: The First Revelation
milestones.description: Your investigators have uncovered the initial threads of the mystery, navigating Arkham's shadowy streets and surviving the first wave of eldritch horrors.

milestones.title: Deeper into the Mythos
milestones.description: The conspiracy runs deeper than anyone imagined. Your investigators press on, their decks honed by hard-won experience, as the Ancient One's influence grows ever stronger.

milestones.title: The Final Resolution
milestones.description: All paths converge as your investigators face the culmination of the campaign cycle. The final resolution will determine the fate of Arkham and the world beyond.
